mapper.select: SELECT "dbd"."daily_bus_daiya_id" , "i"."income_info_id" , "i"."passengers_count" , "i"."cash_income" , "i"."ic_amount" , "i"."coupon_ticket" FROM "daily_bus_daiyas" "dbd" JOIN "bus_services" "bs" ON "bs"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs"."bus_service_id" = "dbd"."bus_service_id" JOIN "daiya_revisions" "dr" ON "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."daiya_revision_id" = "bs"."daiya_revision_id" AND "dr"."service_start_date" <= CAST(#{serviceDate} AS DATE) AND "dr"."service_end_date" >= CAST(#{serviceDate} AS DATE) JOIN "lines" "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "dr"."rosen_id" JOIN "agencies" "a" ON "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" LEFT JOIN "income_info" "i" ON "i"."del_flag" = 0 AND "i"."daily_bus_daiya_id" = "dbd"."daily_bus_daiya_id" WHERE "dbd"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dbd"."sales_cancel_flg" = 0 AND "dbd"."operation_cancel_flg" = 0 AND "dbd"."service_date" = CAST(#{serviceDate} AS DATE) AND "bs"."bus_service_id" = #{busServiceId} AND "l"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} AND "l"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId}
